name: 38-igtuk
description: Igtuk: the Inuit spirit whose jaws make the booming in the mountains -- a long blue-grey beast on four long legs with curled feet, one large eye, a huge upturned jaw, a dark shaggy beard, a hair tuft at its snout tip. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place: it breathes, then opens its huge jaw wide and snaps it shut with a boom, its shaggy beard swinging. Feet planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
